description: This file contains interface definitions, abstract classes, and class implementations related to Orleans serialization and invocation proxies, including method annotations, generic interfaces and classes, reserved keyword handling, and testing classes.

classes.name: MyInvokableProxyBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing mechanisms for invoking actions, managing invokables, and handling context and codecs for Orleans serialization.

classes.name: AltInvokableProxyBase
classes.description: An abstract class similar to MyInvokableProxyBase, with simplified InvokeAsync methods, intended as an alternative proxy base.

classes.name: IMyInvokableBaseType
classes.description: An interface with serializable method serializer generation, used as a marker for invokable types.

classes.name: IProxyAliasTestGrain
classes.description: An interface defining methods with various aliases and serialization IDs for testing aliasing functionality.

classes.name: IGenericProxyAliasTestGrain
classes.description: A generic interface with method aliasing and serialization attributes, for testing generic proxies.

classes.name: G1
classes.description: A generic class inheriting from nested interfaces demonstrating complex generic hierarchies.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: A container class with nested interface and class, used as a namespace for generic types.

classes.name: IGrainWithGenericMethods
classes.description: An interface with generic methods for type reflection and constraints testing.

classes.name: GrainWithGenericMethods
classes.description: An implementation of IGrainWithGenericMethods, with methods for reflecting types, generics, and handling cache.

classes.name: IGenericGrainWithGenericMethods
classes.description: A generic interface with method signatures demonstrating method overloading and generic parameters.

classes.name: IRuntimeCodeGenGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain that handles setting state and testing reserved keyword identifiers.

classes.name: GenericGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class representing grain state with a generic payload, illustrating usage of reserved keywords as member names.

classes.name: @event
classes.description: A class to test handling of reserved keywords in serialization, with equality and hash code implementations, and nested enums.

classes.name: NestedGeneric
classes.description: A generic serializable class with nested class, used to test nested generic serialization.

classes.name: NestedConstructedGeneric
classes.description: A serializable class with a nested generic class and payload, testing nested constructed generics serialization.

classes.name: INestedGenericGrain
classes.description: An interface defining methods for working with nested generic types.

classes.name: NestedGenericGrain
classes.description: A class implementing INestedGenericGrain, returning payloads from nested generic types.

methods.name: GetInvokable
methods.description: Retrieves an invokable object of specified type from the InvokablePool.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Invokes a provided IInvokable asynchronously, with optional callback.

methods.name: GetTypesExplicit
methods.description: Returns array of explicitly specified generic types.

methods.name: GetTypesInferred
methods.description: Returns array of inferred generic types based on method parameters.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Returns the same value passed, testing serialization/deserialization for generics.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Provides default values for specified generic type.

methods.name: Constraints
methods.description: Method with type constraint, returning the input grain.

methods.name: ValueTaskMethod
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask<int> depending on the useCache parameter.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Stores a value in the grain's internal state.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves stored value from internal state.

methods.name: Method
methods.description: Method with generic parameters, demonstrating method overloading and aliasing.
